meta.title: Dele Viaje — Find or Create a Trip
meta.description: Discover and join social trips, book verified tours, or collaborate on private plans with friends and family in Costa Rica and beyond.

pwa.installHint: Install Dele Viaje: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".

hero.subtext: Join social adventures, book verified tours, or plan a private trip with friends across Costa Rica.

howItWorks.title: Three ways to hit the trail

social.title: Join a social trip
social.body: Browse open trips from fellow explorers, request a spot, and head out with a group that shares your pace.

tour.title: Book a verified tour
tour.body: Reserve directly with licensed local agencies, no middleman markup.

private.title: Plan a private trip
private.body: Organize the itinerary, split costs, and coordinate with friends and family in one shared space.

agenciesCta.title: Run tours in Costa Rica?
agenciesCta.body: We are onboarding a founding group of local operators before launch, with direct bookings and no middleman markup.

waitlist.title: Be first on the trail
waitlist.body: We are building Dele Viaje right now. Join the waitlist and we will email you the moment it opens.
waitlist.success: You are on the list. Watch your inbox for launch day.

footer.tagline: Trips across Costa Rica, planned with people you trust.
footer.copyright: Copyright {year} Dele Viaje. Made in Costa Rica.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.subtitle: Join Dele Viaje to find or create your next trip.
signup.passwordHelper: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link to finish creating your account. Open it to continue to Dele Viaje.

onboarding.title: Tell us about you
onboarding.subtitle: A few details before you start planning trips.
onboarding.categoriesSubtitle: Optional, helps us tailor what you see.

feed.title: Upcoming trips
feed.subtitle: Social trips published by the community.
feed.emptyBody: Be the first to organize one.
feed.noResultsBody: Try another category or view all trips.

trips.newSubtitle: Publish a free social trip for other explorers to join.
trips.titlePlaceholder: E.g. Cerro Chirripó hike this Saturday
trips.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell people what you'll do, what to bring, and what to expect.
trips.locationPlaceholder: E.g. Bus station, San Isidro de El General
trips.genericError: Could not create the trip. Try again.
trips.endBeforeStart: End date must be after the start date.
trips.confirmLeaveBody: You'll lose your confirmed spot. If there's a waitlist, someone else may take your place.
trips.confirmLeaveWaitlistBody: You'll be removed from this trip's waitlist.
trips.joinError: Could not complete the action. Try again.
trips.noAttendeesYet: No one has joined yet. Be the first!

chat.title: Trip chat
chat.empty: No messages yet. Be the first to say something!
chat.readOnlyNote: You're on the waitlist: you can read the chat, but can't post until your spot is confirmed.
chat.notAllowed: Only trip participants can view this chat.
chat.sendError: Could not send the message. Try again.
